title: The Choice of the Twin Fates
next_chapter_hook: Before the Demonic Path commander finished speaking, a complex emotion flickered in his eyes—the truth of Ye Qing's betrayal was inextricably linked to the chess game of fate that Chen Ji had been pursuing for years.

text.content: The power of the Tianji Record surged like molten lava through Chen Ji's meridians, roaring and raging. That cold voice still echoed in his ears—the death date of Chapter 700 was inescapable. Every inch of his skin was burning, as if countless tiny runes were traveling beneath his skin, inscribing some indescribable contract.

dialogue.content: Death date? Chen Ji sneered in his heart, his fingertips gently stroking the nascent golden pattern on his chest. The Heavenly Dao wanted to trap him with a countdown, but it didn't know that time had always been his most skilled chessboard. Three hundred chapters of planning—the victory never depended on living long enough, but on dying cleverly enough.

text.content: Inside the Demonic Path command tent, the candlelight flickered. Chen Ji stood before the sand table, his gaze sweeping across the chess pieces marking the territories of the three great sects. Across from him, the Demonic Path commander—an中年男子 in a black robe—was studying him with a scrutinizing gaze, his lips carrying a faint, mocking smile.

dialogue.content: This junior came today to discuss an unprecedented possibility with the senior. Chen Ji's voice remained steady, neither servile nor arrogant. For ten thousand years, the Orthodox and Demonic Paths have been like twin fates of destiny, each waning as the other waxes, constantly devouring each other. This junior wishes to ask—if these twin fates were not destined to determine a victor, but could instead merge into one?

The Demonic Path commander threw his head back in laughter, the sound vibrating so forcefully that dust fell from the tent's ceiling. Merge? He收起笑容, his gaze suddenly sharp and piercing. You废物 from the Tianqing Sect, do you know how many brilliant and talented individuals have attempted this path over the millennia? Their bones formed mountains, their resentful spirits remain scattered to this day! Under the backlash of karma, no one could escape unscathed!

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged. He slowly raised his right hand. In his palm, a complete golden page materialized, the flowing runes upon it many times more intricate than before. The complete form of the Tianji Record was revealed to the world for the first time—it was no longer a fragment, but a true scripture capable of rewriting fate.

dialogue.content: Please observe, senior. Chen Ji gently flipped the page, and countless intersecting threads of causality materialized in the air. The reason the failures of ten thousand years ago failed was because they tried to forcefully merge through power. This junior is different—the Tianji Record's writing of fate is not about conquest, but about rewriting. What this junior intends to do is redefine causality itself.

The Demonic Path commander's pupils slightly contracted. As an old fox who had immersed himself in the Demonic Path for decades, he instantly judged that the power contained within that golden page far exceeded his comprehension. But his seasoned experience made him refrain from immediately responding, and he asked in a deep voice: Even if you possess the ability to rewrite causality, what makes you believe you should become the dominant entity after the merger?

text.content: At this moment, the tent's curtain was gently lifted. A cold, clear voice came from the doorway—If the senior wouldn't mind, this young woman would be willing to serve as a witness to this matter. Chen Ling walked in gracefully, a faint smile on her face, and those clear eyes flickered with some kind of ancient radiance.

dialogue.content: I am the Lock of Heavenly Fate, and also an existence beyond causality. Chen Ling's voice was gentle yet firm. Having me supervise the fusion process can ensure neither party suffers karmic backlash at a critical moment. This is my value, and the only thing I can contribute to this matter.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji sensed the crucial turning point of the situation—the Demonic Path commander was already wavering, but when deciding his next strategy, he needed to consider multiple dimensions of risk and benefit: forcing the issue might provoke the other's wariness, while excessive concession might miss the perfect opportunity. In this game, Chen Ji had to make a choice.

choices.description: Honestly tell the Demonic Path commander about the threat of the Heavenly Eye, propose joining hands to break the encirclement first, and discuss the details of fusion later. This is the safest option, but may be seen as weakness.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path's trust and reach a preliminary alliance
choices.risk_hint: If the other party takes the opportunity to strike, Chen Ji will lose the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a decision that surprised the Demonic Path commander—he gently set down the Tianji Record in his hand and actively stepped back. The senior is right; the matter of fusion truly cannot be rushed. This junior suggests we discuss a more pressing matter first.

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye. Chen Ji's voice suddenly dropped lower, revealing a rare gravity. The senior should know that we are being watched by an transcendent existence. The chess game it has set up has stretched for ten thousand years, and both you and I are merely pieces on its board. This junior wishes to ask—will the senior join hands with me to first break the encirclement of this chessboard?

choices.description: Directly display the complete power of the Tianji Record and force the Demonic Path commander to submit. This is the highest-risk option, but if successful, it will directly establish Chen Ji's dominant position.
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will completely establish dominance
choices.risk_hint: If the other party would rather die than submit, Chen Ji will pay an enormous price

text.content: Chen Ji slightly raised the corner of his mouth, revealing a meaningful smile. Without another word, he gently pushed the Tianji Record forward. Golden pages suddenly unfolded in the air, countless runes spreading like substantial light in all directions, shrouding the entire tent in an indescribable pressure.

dialogue.content: "Senior, perhaps you are not yet aware that after the Tianji Record is complete, the junior has the ability to directly rewrite causality." Chen Ji's voice remained calm, but the content of his words caused the Demonic Path Commander's expression to slightly change. "The junior is not threatening the senior, merely wanting the senior to understand—this path, the junior has decided to take. As for how to walk it, that depends on the senior's attitude."

The Demonic Path Commander fell silent for a moment, his gaze shifting between Chen Ji and Chen Ling. Finally, he sighed, and a rare weariness appeared on his aged face. "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets you speak of, the old man is not unaware of. The tentacles of that catastrophe ten thousand years ago already reached toward the Demonic Path. I simply never imagined its reach would extend so far—even reducing a Tianqing Sect废物 to a mere chess piece."

text.content: The atmosphere inside the tent suddenly froze. Chen Ji noticed that when the Demonic Path Commander said this, a subtle complexity flashed across his eyes—not merely wariness, but more like the pain of an old wound being exposed. Chen Ling beside him nodded lightly, as if already anticipating this answer.

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander's response made Chen Ji realize that this negotiation might be more complex than he anticipated. What kind of layout had the Eye of Heavenly Secrets left in the Demonic Path ten thousand years ago? And what did the Demonic Path Commander's complicated gaze hint at? Between pursuing the truth and temporarily setting it aside, Chen Ji needed to make a choice.

choices.description: "Pursue the truth about the catastrophe ten thousand years ago. This might reveal more secrets about the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, but could also touch upon the other party's forbidden zones."
choices.risk_hint: If the other party is unwilling to discuss further, it may affect the current negotiation atmosphere

dialogue.content: "Ten thousand years ago?" Chen Ji keenly caught this keyword, his eyes flashing brilliantly. "The senior's reference to the catastrophe ten thousand years ago—could it be referring to that upheaval that completely reshaped the landscape of the righteous and demonic paths? The junior's records in the Tianji Record are limited. I ask the senior to enlighten me."

The Demonic Path Commander glanced at Chen Ji, seemingly weighing something. After a moment, he slowly spoke: "The cause of that catastrophe was precisely the first person who attempted to merge the righteous and demonic paths. His failure caused the Eye of Heavenly Secrets to completely seal this path. And now..." He paused, his gaze falling on Chen Ji, "does this thing in your hand actually possess the power to rewrite causality?"

choices.description: "Temporarily refrain from pursuing the details of the catastrophe ten thousand years ago, focusing on the current alliance agreement. Pragmatic but may miss important information."
choices.risk_hint: Insufficient intelligence may lead to flawed decision-making in the future

text.content: Chen Ji did not pursue the question. He deeply understood that some secrets needed to be exchanged with time, not forcibly demanded at the negotiation table. "Since the senior knows the existence of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, our goals are aligned." Chen Ji steered the conversation back on track, "Why don't we first discuss immediate matters—how to break its blockade?"

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander nodded, a hint of approval flashing in his eyes. This young man was more composed than he had imagined. "Very well, let's discuss immediate matters first." He waved his hand, dismissing others from the tent, then lowered his voice: "According to the old man's knowledge, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' blockade has three layers. To break it, one must simultaneously attack from three directions."

Just then, a commotion suddenly arose outside the tent. The Demonic Path Commander's expression darkened. Before he could speak, the tent curtain was already flung open. A Demonic Path scout stumbled in, face full of panic: "Commander! Bad news! Ye Qing, the Saint... she's leading the Holy Sect forces, closing in on us!"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Ye Qing—that Demonic Path Saint whom he once believed had formed an alliance. He下意识地 glanced at Chen Ling, only to find her expression unusually calm, as if she had long known about this. Chen Ling met his gaze, gently shaking her head, her eyes revealing a complex emotion.

dialogue.content: Chen Ling's voice was very soft, audible only to Chen Ji: "Brother, Ye Qing's matter is far more complex than you imagine. She hasn't betrayed us, but is executing some... more ancient plan." These words made Chen Ji's heart sink heavily. The Tianji Record's warnings had never been wrong, but at this moment, he suddenly realized that perhaps the true chess game was far deeper than what he could see.

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander's face had already turned extremely gloomy. He looked at Chen Ji, his gaze carrying scrutiny and probing: "Tianqing Sect youth, you'd better give the old man an explanation. This so-called cooperation of yours—could it be a scheme to invite wolves into the house?" Outside the tent, the sounds of battle grew closer. Chen Ji knew he had to prove his innocence quickly.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's sudden appearance caused the situation to take a sharp turn. The Demonic Path Commander's trust was wavering, while the enemy outside closed in step by step. Chen Ji had to make a decision within limited time—force a breakout, or find another way out?"

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to reveal Ye Qing's true intentions, allowing the Demonic Path commander to see that Chen Ji has not deceived. This is the most direct way to prove innocence, but it will expose more trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: The abilities of the Tianji Record are further exposed
choices.visible_reward: Clear suspicion and consolidate the alliance
choices.risk_hint: If the other party covets the Tianji Record, the consequences will be boundless

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He unfurled the Tianji Record, and a golden light projected onto the tent's dome. It was a scene—Ye Qing kneeling before a massive eyeball, an eyeball radiating a suffocating aura of Heavenly Dao, and the words spilling from Ye Qing's mouth made everyone's expression change drastically.

dialogue.content: This is the karmic imprint left when Ye Qing was controlled by the Holy Sect. Chen Ji's voice was calm, yet carried undeniable force. She did not betray, but was forced to execute orders. Her true mission is to monitor the chess pieces buried by the Eye of Heavenly Dao between our two factions—including Elder, including the junior, and also including... He looked at Chen Ling, everyone present.

choices.description: Propose joining forces with the Demonic Path commander to strike, creating an escape opportunity amid the chaos. This requires tacit coordination between both parties, but the risk is extremely high.
choices.risk_hint: If coordination fails, it may lead to total annihilation

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, making a bold proposal: Elder, no amount of explanation matters now. Let us join hands and seize the opportunity in the chaos. The junior has a way to break through, but needs Elder to hold off the Holy Sect's masters for a moment.

The Demonic Path commander stared at Chen Ji for three breaths, then suddenly burst into laughter. Good! This old one has traversed the Demonic Path for hundreds of years, and today I shall wager this bet—let's see what you're truly made of, you废物 of the Tianqing Sect! His voice carried a hint of anticipation and a touch of trial.

text.content: The sounds of battle outside the tent were now at their doorstep. Firelight illuminated Chen Ji's face, yet his gaze remained exceptionally calm. The deadline of Chapter 700 cannot be avoided—this phrase echoed in his mind, but did not shake his heart in the slightest. A true hunter always bares its fangs at the most dangerous moment.

dialogue.content: Elder, we shall discuss the matter of fusion later. Chen Ji cast one final glance at the Demonic Path commander, his eyes revealing an unprecedented determination. Now, let us show the Eye of Heavenly Dao that the chess game it personally arranged is being overturned by the very piece it most despised. As his words fell, he was the first to push aside the tent curtain, facing the blades and arrows.

text.content: The night wind howled, flames lit up the sky. The Demonic Path commander gazed at Chen Ji's retreating figure, a complex light flickering in his aged eyes. This废物 disciple of the Tianqing Sect had risen at a speed far beyond his expectations. Perhaps, as the other party had said, the direction of this chess game had begun to deviate from the control of the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

Chen Ling followed closely behind, the power of the Heavenly Fate Lock forming a faint barrier around her. Amid the chaotic battlefield, her voice clearly reached Chen Ji's ears: Brother, Sister Ye Qing is right in the center of the enemy formation. She's waiting for us. This sentence dispersed the last trace of doubt in Chen Ji's heart. All the scheming, all the pretense, would now face its final revelation.

And just as the battle was about to erupt, the Demonic Path commander's voice suddenly came from behind, carrying an indescribable nuance: Chen Ji young friend, before we act, this old one must tell you something—the true reason for Ye Qing's betrayal is not as simple as what you witnessed. She... is also part of the fate's chess game, and the bond between you and her may be far deeper than you could imagine.
